game_abilities.title_en: Gains a Special Damage Buff every {{var_1}}, increasing Special Damage by {{var_2}}. (Max: 6 stacks).
game_abilities.desc_zh: 每 {{var_1}} 获得一个特殊伤害增益，将特殊伤害增加 {{var_2}}。 （最多：6 堆）。

game_abilities.title_en: Once Mixmaster finishes generating Special Damage Buffs, he begins generating a Critical Damage Buff every {{var_3}}, each adding {{var_4}} Critical Damage. (Max: 6 Stacks)
game_abilities.desc_zh: 一旦 Mixmaster 完成生成特殊伤害增益，他就会开始在每个 {{var_3}} 生成一个致命伤害增益，每个都会增加 {{var_4}} 致命伤害。 （最多：6 层）

game_abilities.title_en: These Buffs are removed after Mixmaster successfully lands the last hit of a Special Attack.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 在 Mixmaster 成功完成特殊技的最后一击后，这些增益会被移除。

game_abilities.title_en: {{var_5}} chance to inflict Acid, dealing {{var_6}} Attack as chemical damage over {{var_7}}seconds and corroding 1 Resistance Buff every {{var_8}}(s).
game_abilities.desc_zh: {{var_5}} 有机会造成酸，在 {{var_7}} 秒内造成 {{var_6}} 攻击化学伤害，并每 {{var_8}} 腐蚀 1 个抵抗增益。

game_abilities.title_en: +{{var_9}} Critical Rate if the opponent is under the effect of a Debuff.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 如果对手受到减益效果，则 +{{var_9}} 暴击率。
